product_one_liner.value: CompanyCam is a jobsite documentation and productivity platform that helps contractors capture project photos, coordinate crews, and share progress with clients.
product_one_liner.notes: CompanyCam describes a contractor-focused jobsite productivity platform for documenting jobs, communicating with crews, and sharing progress with clients: https://companycam.com/press.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists plans, user allowances, and additional-user pricing: https://companycam.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: CompanyCam’s case studies describe Best Roofing’s rollout and Apple Roofing’s benefits after implementation, establishing both as customers: https://companycam.com/resources/case-studies/best-roofing and https://companycam.com/resources/case-studies/apple-roofing. | named_customers.0: The CompanyCam customer case study includes a testimonial attributed to Best Roofing’s executive assistant: https://companycam.com/resources/case-studies/best-roofing. | named_customers.1: The case study explicitly describes Apple Roofing’s benefits after implementing CompanyCam: https://companycam.com/resources/case-studies/apple-roofing.

employee_band.notes: CompanyCam’s company profile lists a 201–500 employee size band and 365 associated employees: https://linkedin.com/company/companycam.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Both company profiles identify Lincoln as CompanyCam’s headquarters: https://linkedin.com/company/companycam and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/companycam/__eWj-jyb42WvkkkABaxK1QD9XJKLGEpe6viHxjDlklho. | hq_country: The company profile identifies CompanyCam’s headquarters as Lincoln, United States: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/companycam/__eWj-jyb42WvkkkABaxK1QD9XJKLGEpe6viHxjDlklho. This is a secondary-source headquarters attribution.

founded_year.notes: CompanyCam’s press page explicitly states that it was founded in 2015: https://companycam.com/press.

eng_blog.notes: CompanyCam publishes Chad Wilken’s posts on asynchronous Searchkick reindexing and Sidekiq request-ID tracking, both about building its software. Wilken is independently identified as CompanyCam’s founding engineer. Sources: https://dev.to/companycam/building-a-workflow-for-async-searchkick-reindexing-4mk8, https://dev.to/companycam/sidekiq-request-id-tracking-2cdm, and https://yespress.io/chad-wilken.

public_docs.notes: The public developer documentation index links multiple substantive articles, including the API reference, OAuth authentication, and webhooks: https://developers.companycam.com/llms.txt. The portal is https://developers.companycam.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current job board lists engineering, analytics, marketing, product, sales, and support roles, but none has a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. The marketing analyst role does not qualify under the stated exclusions: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/companycam.

model_provider.notes: A CompanyCam engineer’s project portfolio explicitly says the team shipped using Anthropic, OpenAI, and Groq. This is a public implementation account rather than an official company provider disclosure: https://austn.net/work/companycam.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company publicly claims SOC 2 Type II certification and GDPR compliance. Only the requested frameworks explicitly named on this page are included: https://companycam.com/trust-center. | compliance_certs.0: CompanyCam explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II certification: https://companycam.com/trust-center. | compliance_certs.1: CompanyCam explicitly claims GDPR compliance: https://companycam.com/trust-center.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company announcement calls the investment a Series C transaction, and the funding profile identifies it as the latest Series C round. raised_18mo.notes: CompanyCam announced its Series C investment on August 21, 2025, within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/companycam-secures-strategic-growth-investment-from-b-capital-302535365.html.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current board has no role explicitly titled SDR, BDR, Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative, or Account Executive. Its Inside Sales Representative opening is not counted under that restricted title definition. Sources: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/companycam and https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/companycam/f06dd43d-f2d7-41e9-b064-3c004f29f703.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 8, 2026, CompanyCam announced document creation and editing through its API and MCP, expanding beyond read-only access. This substantive integration capability falls within the requested six-month window: https://intercom.news/companycam/156729-more-of-your-companycam-data-is-now-open-to-the-tools-you-already-use.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Saliq Hussaini’s profile lists a July 2026 start as CompanyCam’s VP, Embedded Finance & Payments, following his role at Beam. That falls within the requested 12-month window: https://linkedin.com/in/saliqhussaini.
